donor_domain: evolutionary computation / fitness-landscape theory (neutral networks; Kimura neutral theory as biological parent)

donor_structure: neutral network = connected component of equal-fitness genotypes under single-point mutation in sequence space; degree of neutrality; percolation of neutral networks enabling drift-escape from local optima
target_structure: optimizer neutral set = level set of the search objective over states connected under the optimizer's move/neighborhood operator, on which the optimizer receives no gradient in objective value
mapping: genotype->search state; fitness->objective value; single-point mutation->neighborhood/move operator of optimizer; neutral network->neutral set (connected level set); population drift along network->optimizer plateau walk
preserved_relations: connectedness of the equal-value region under the move operator
escape from local optima via traversal along the neutral region (percolation-dependent)
degree of neutrality as measurable scalar
known_broken_relations: no population semantics in a single optimizer trajectory (drift argument uses population diversity)
fitness landscape assumes fixed landscape; HSG objectives change across t (broken, flagged)
unknown_correspondences: whether neutral-set percolation thresholds transfer from sequence spaces (Hamming cubes) to HSG state spaces under burden-bounded moves
assumptions_added: objective fixed during the neutral-set analysis (single-episode freeze)
move operator induces a connected graph on the state space
candidate_theorem: a plateau walk on a percolating neutral set reaches states outside any epsilon-ball of the origin with probability 1 under unbiased moves, in time O(diameter) -- donor percolation phenomenology restated in atom vocabulary
strongest_parent: neutral-network percolation phenomenology (EC/fitness-landscape literature; Kimura 1968 neutral theory as context)
route: empirical/finite (percolation statistics measurable on instance landscapes); no proof attempted in this arm
status_self_assessment: surface-strong transport but donor supplies phenomenology, not a theorem; single-chart arm did not test percolation transfer; PROPOSAL
